        local popup
        local function closePopup() if popup then popup:Destroy(); popup = nil end end
        local function playerNames()
            local names = { "None" }
            for _, player in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
                if player ~= LocalPlayer then names[#names + 1] = player.Name end
            end
            table.sort(names, function(a, b)
                if a == "None" then return true end
                if b == "None" then return false end
                return string.lower(a) < string.lower(b)
            end)
            return names
        end
        local function openPopup()
            closePopup()
            refreshRoles()
            local names = playerNames()
            local scaleVal = (scale and scale.Scale) or 1
            popup = New("ScrollingFrame", { Parent = gui, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ddBtn.AbsolutePosition.X / scaleVal, (ddBtn.AbsolutePosition.Y + ddBtn.AbsoluteSize.Y + 4) / scaleVal),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ddBtn.AbsoluteSize.X / scaleVal, math.min(#names * 38, 190)), CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, #names * 38),
                BackgroundColor3 = C.surface, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 4, ZIndex = 50 })
            corner(popup, 10); stroke(popup, C.accent, .2)
            New("UIListLayout", { Parent = popup, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
            for _, name in ipairs(names) do
                local item = New("TextButton", { Parent = popup, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = tostring(name),
                    TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, ZIndex = 51, AutoButtonColor = false })
                local function pick()
                    ddBtn.Text = tostring(name) .. "  ⌄"
                    closePopup()
                    if name == "None" then return end
                    local player = Players:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if player then tpToPlayer(player) end
                end
                item.MouseButton1Click:Connect(pick)
                item.Activated:Connect(pick)
            end
        end
        ddBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(openPopup)
        ddBtn.Activated:Connect(openPopup)
        local bus = getgenv().__NoirV4RoleBus
        if bus and bus.Subscribe then bus:Subscribe(function() task.defer(refreshRoles) end) end
        refreshRoles()
    end
end

do
    local function buildAutofarmUI()
        local page = win:FindFirstChild("FarmContent")
        local col = page and page:FindFirstChild("NoirColumn1")
        if page and col then
            local function panel(title, subtitle)
                local card = New("Frame", { Parent = col, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 90), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                    BackgroundColor3 = C.panel, BackgroundTransparency = .25, ClipsDescendants = true })
                table.insert(sectionPanels, { panel = card, page = "farm", name = string.lower(title .. " " .. (subtitle or "") .. " autofarm farm coins coin") })
                corner(card, 18); stroke(card, C.border, .5)
                local tick = New("Frame", { Parent = card, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 20), BackgroundColor3 = C.accent })
                corner(tick, 2)
                text(card, title, 18, UDim2.fromOffset(24, 16))
                if subtitle and subtitle ~= "" then text(card, subtitle, 12, UDim2.fromOffset(24, 44), true) end
                local holder = New("Frame", { Parent = card, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, subtitle ~= "" and 74 or 57), Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 0),
                    AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
                New("UIListLayout", { Parent = holder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
                New("UIPadding", { Parent = holder, PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12) })
                return holder
            end
            local function makeToggle(parent, label, callback, startOn)
                local state = false
                local r = New("Frame", { Parent = parent, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
                text(r, label, 16, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 10))
                local pill = New("TextButton", { Parent = r, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 8), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 34),
                    BackgroundColor3 = C.off, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false })
                corner(pill, 17); stroke(pill, C.border, .55)
                local dot = New("Frame", { Parent = pill, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 155, 162) })
                corner(dot, 13)
                local function apply(v)
                    state = v == true
                    TweenService:Create(pill, TweenInfo.new(.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundColor3 = state and C.accent or C.off }):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(dot, TweenInfo.new(.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                        Position = state and UDim2.fromOffset(34, 4) or UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4),
                        BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 155, 162)
                    }):Play()
                    callback(state)
                end
                local last = 0
                local function fire()
                    local now = os.clock()
                    if now - last < .18 then return end
                    last = now
                    apply(not state)
                end
                pill.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fire)
                pill.Activated:Connect(fire)
                if startOn == true then apply(true) end
                return apply
            end
            local farming, resetFull, avoidOn, antiAfkOn, noRenderOn, killAllOn, shootMurdOn, rstM, rstS, auraOn = false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false
            local bagIsFull = false
            local farmMode, returnTo = "Smooth", "Start"
            local spd, dly = 32, 1
            local auraRadius = 20
            local startCF, lastMapCF, holdReturnUntil, statusLbl, afkConn, farmTween = nil, nil, 0, nil, nil, nil
            local touched, seen, collected, sessionStart = {}, {}, 0, 0
            local trackedBox, cachedBox, cachedModel = nil, nil, nil
            local lobbyCache, lobbyTried, lastBagT = nil, false, 0
            local origDestroyH = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
            local function farmKey(k) return "Autofarm3::" .. k end
            local function farmRead(bag, key, def)
                local store = NoirPersistence.data[bag]
                if type(store) ~= "table" then return def end
                local v = store[farmKey(key)]
                if v == nil then return def end
                return v
            end
            local function farmWrite(bag, key, val)
                NoirPersistence.data[bag][farmKey(key)] = val
                NoirPersistence.Save()
            end
            spd = math.clamp(tonumber(farmRead("sliders", "Farm Speed", 32)) or 32, 5, 50)
            dly = math.clamp(tonumber(farmRead("sliders", "Farm Delay", 1)) or 1, 0, 10)
            auraRadius = math.clamp(tonumber(farmRead("sliders", "Aura Radius", 20)) or 20, 5, 60)
            farmMode = farmRead("dropdowns", "Mode", "Smooth")
            if farmMode ~= "Smooth" and farmMode ~= "Lay" then farmMode = "Smooth" end
            returnTo = farmRead("dropdowns", "Return", "Start")
            if returnTo ~= "Map" and returnTo ~= "Lobby" then returnTo = "Start" end
            local function setStatus(msg)
                if statusLbl then statusLbl.Text = msg end
            end
            local function touch(a, b)
                pcall(function()
                    firetouchinterest(a, b, 0)
                    firetouchinterest(a, b, 1)
                end)
            end
            local function getContainer()
                if cachedBox and cachedBox.Parent then return cachedBox end
                cachedBox, cachedModel = nil, nil
                for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                    if (child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("Folder")) and child:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer") then
                        cachedBox, cachedModel = child.CoinContainer, child
                        return cachedBox
                    end
                end
                local box = workspace:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
                if box then cachedBox, cachedModel = box, box.Parent; return box end
                local ok, found = pcall(function() return workspace:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer", true) end)
                if ok and found then cachedBox, cachedModel = found, found.Parent; return found end
                return nil
            end
            local function markTouched(part)
                if touched[part] then return end
                touched[part] = true
                collected = collected + 1
            end
            local function isCollected(part)
                local vis = part:FindFirstChild("CoinVisual")
                if vis and vis:GetAttribute("Collected") then return true end
                return part:GetAttribute("Collected") == true
            end
            local function scanCoins()
                local out = {}
                local box = getContainer()
                if not box then return out end
                if box ~= trackedBox then
                    trackedBox = box
                    touched, seen = {}, {}
                    collected, sessionStart = 0, os.clock()
                end
                for part in pairs(seen) do
                    if not part.Parent or isCollected(part) then markTouched(part) end
                end
                local ok, descs = pcall(function() return box:GetDescendants() end)
                if not ok or not descs then return out end
                for n = 1, #descs do
                    local d = descs[n]
                    if d.Name == "TouchInterest" or d:IsA("TouchTransmitter") then
                        local part = d.Parent
                        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and not touched[part] then
                            if isCollected(part) then
                                markTouched(part)
                            else
                                local y = seen[part]
                                if y == nil then
                                    seen[part] = part.Position.Y
                                    out[#out + 1] = part
                                elseif math.abs(part.Position.Y - y) > 0.5 then
                                    markTouched(part)
                                else
                                    out[#out + 1] = part
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #out == 0 then
                    for _, child in ipairs(box:GetChildren()) do
                        if not touched[child] and child:IsA("BasePart") and not isCollected(child) then
                            seen[child] = seen[child] or child.Position.Y
                            out[#out + 1] = child
                        end
                    end
                end
                return out
            end
            local function roundActiveNow()
                if getContainer() then return true end
                local ok, res = pcall(function()
                    local mg = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
                    local g = mg and mg:FindFirstChild("Game")
                    if not g then return false end
                    local t = g:FindFirstChild("Timer")
                    if t and t.Visible then return true end
                    local xp = g:FindFirstChild("EarnedXP")
                    if xp and xp.Visible then return true end
                    return false
                end)
                if ok and res == true then return true end
                return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Alive") == true
            end
            local function bagFullGui()
                local ok, res = pcall(function()
                    local mg = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
                    mg = mg and mg:FindFirstChild("Game")
                    mg = mg and mg:FindFirstChild("CoinBags")
                    mg = mg and mg:FindFirstChild("Container")
                    if not mg then return false end
                    for _, bag in ipairs(mg:GetChildren()) do
                        local fb = bag:FindFirstChild("FullBagIcon") or bag:FindFirstChild("Full")
                        if fb and fb.Visible then return true end
                    end
                    return false
                end)
                return ok and res == true
            end
            local function hasTool(name)
                local char, bp = LocalPlayer.Character, LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
                return (char and char:FindFirstChild(name)) or (bp and bp:FindFirstChild(name))
            end
            local function doKillAll()
                local rt = getgenv().__NoirKnifeUtilityRuntime
                if rt and rt.KillEveryone then
                    pcall(function() rt:KillEveryone() end)
                    return
                end
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                local knife = char and char:FindFirstChild("Knife") or (LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack") and LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife"))
                local ht = knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Events") and knife.Events:FindFirstChild("HandleTouched")
                if not ht then return end
                for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
                        local tgt = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if tgt then pcall(function() ht:FireServer(tgt) end) end
                    end
                end
            end
            local function doShootMurd()
                task.spawn(function()
                    local murd = findByKnife and findByKnife()
                    if not murd or not murd.Character then return end
                    if type(fireGunAt) == "function" then
                        pcall(function() fireGunAt(murd, true) end)
                    end
                end)
            end
            local function voidDrop()
                local r = localRoot()
                if r then pcall(function() r.CFrame = CFrame.new(r.Position.X, -500, r.Position.Z) end) end
            end
            local function maybeRoleReset(hum)
                if (rstM and hasTool("Knife")) or (rstS and hasTool("Gun")) then
                    voidDrop()
                    hum.Health = 0
                end
            end
            local function firstPartOf(inst)
                if inst:IsA("BasePart") then return inst end
                return inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            end
            local function lobbyCF()
                if lobbyCache then return lobbyCache end
                for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("Model") and string.find(string.lower(child.Name), "lobby", 1, true) then
                        local p = firstPartOf(child)
                        if p then lobbyCache = p.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0); return lobbyCache end
                    end
                end
                if not lobbyTried then
                    lobbyTried = true
                    local ok, spawns = pcall(function()
                        local list = {}
                        for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                            if d:IsA("SpawnLocation") then list[#list + 1] = d end
                        end
                        return list
                    end)
                    if ok and spawns then
                        for _, s in ipairs(spawns) do
                            if not (cachedModel and s:IsDescendantOf(cachedModel)) then
                                lobbyCache = s.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                                return lobbyCache
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            local function goReturn()
                local r = localRoot()
                if not r then return false end
                local cf
                if returnTo == "Lobby" then cf = lobbyCF()
                elseif returnTo == "Map" then cf = (getContainer() and lastMapCF) or lobbyCF()
                else cf = startCF end
                if not cf then return false end
                r.CFrame = cf
                pcall(function()
                    r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end)
                return true
            end
            local function setAfk(on)
                if on then
                    pcall(function()
                        local gc = getconnections or get_signal_cons
                        if gc then
                            for _, v in pairs(gc(LocalPlayer.Idled)) do
                                if v.Disable then pcall(v.Disable, v) elseif v.Disconnect then pcall(v.Disconnect, v) end
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                    if not afkConn then
                        afkConn = LocalPlayer.Idled:Connect(function()
                            pcall(function()
                                local vu = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
                                vu:CaptureController()
                                vu:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
                            end)
                        end)
                    end
                else
                    if afkConn then afkConn:Disconnect(); afkConn = nil end
                end
            end
            local function setNoRender(on)
                pcall(function() RunService:Set3dRenderingEnabled(not on) end)
            end
            local function poseAt(part)
                local pos = part.Position
                if farmMode == "Lay" then
                    return CFrame.new(pos.X, pos.Y - 2.7, pos.Z) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
                end
                return CFrame.new(pos.X, pos.Y + 1.2, pos.Z)
            end
            local function cancelTween()
                if farmTween then
                    pcall(function() farmTween:Cancel() end)
                    farmTween = nil
                end
            end
            local function moveToCoin(dest)
                local r = localRoot()
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                if not r or not char then return end
                cancelTween()
                pcall(function()
                    local h = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if h then h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) end
                end)
                local dist = (r.Position - dest.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < 0.5 then
                    r.CFrame = dest
                    return
                end
                local dur = math.clamp(dist / math.clamp(spd, 5, 50), 0.06, 30)
                local tw = TweenService:Create(r, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { CFrame = dest })
                farmTween = tw
                tw:Play()
                local t0 = os.clock()
                while farming and tw.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing do
                    if os.clock() - t0 > dur + 2 then break end
                    task.wait()
                end
                cancelTween()
                pcall(function() local r2 = localRoot(); if r2 then r2.CFrame = dest end end)
            end
            local function restoreHumanoid()
                pcall(function()
                    local h = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if h then
                        h.PlatformStand = false
                        h.AutoRotate = true
                        h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics)
                    end
                end)
            end
            local function stopFarm()
                cancelTween()
                pcall(function() workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = origDestroyH end)
                setNoRender(false)
                restoreHumanoid()
                goReturn()
                setStatus("Idle")
            end
            local auraThread = nil
            local function auraTick()
                local root = localRoot()
                if not root then return end
                local box = getContainer()
                if not box then return end
                local ok, descs = pcall(function() return box:GetDescendants() end)
                if not ok or not descs then return end
                local pos = root.Position
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                for n = 1, #descs do
                    local d = descs[n]
                    if d.Name == "TouchInterest" or d:IsA("TouchTransmitter") then
                        local part = d.Parent
                        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and not touched[part] and not isCollected(part) and (part.Position - pos).Magnitude <= auraRadius then
                            touch(root, part)
                            if char then
                                for _, bp in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                                    if bp:IsA("BasePart") then touch(bp, part) end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            pcall(function()
                local gp = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                gp = gp and gp:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
                local ev = gp and gp:FindFirstChild("CoinCollected")
                if ev and ev.OnClientEvent then
                    ev.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(_, current, max)
                        current, max = tonumber(current), tonumber(max)
                        if current and max and current >= max then bagIsFull = true end
                    end)
                end
                local function roundReset()
                    bagIsFull = false
                    touched, seen = {}, {}
                    collected, sessionStart = 0, os.clock()
                    lobbyTried = false
                    lobbyCache = nil
                    cancelTween()
                    local c = LocalPlayer.Character
                    if c and farming then startCF = c:GetPivot() end
                end
                local e2 = gp and gp:FindFirstChild("RoundEndFade")
                if e2 and e2.OnClientEvent then e2.OnClientEvent:Connect(roundReset) end
                local e2b = gp and gp:FindFirstChild("RoundEnd")
                if e2b and e2b.OnClientEvent then e2b.OnClientEvent:Connect(roundReset) end
                local e3 = gp and gp:FindFirstChild("RoundStart")
                if e3 and e3.OnClientEvent then e3.OnClientEvent:Connect(roundReset) end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                    task.wait(0.25)
                    restoreHumanoid()
                    if farming then
                        holdReturnUntil = os.clock() + 0.9
                        goReturn()
                        setStatus("Return To " .. returnTo)
                    end
                end)
            end)
            local function farmBtn(parent, label, fn)
                local b = New("TextButton", { Parent = parent, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46), BackgroundColor3 = C.btn,
                    Text = label, TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = 15, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, AutoButtonColor = false })
                corner(b, 12); stroke(b, C.border, .5)
                b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fn)
                b.Activated:Connect(fn)
                return b
            end
            local function makeFarmSlider(parent, label, minV, maxV, default, cb)
                local r = New("Frame", { Parent = parent, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 68), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
                text(r, label, 16, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 8))
                local value = New("TextBox", { Parent = r, Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0, 5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 30), BackgroundColor3 = C.surface,
                    BackgroundTransparency = .12, Text = tostring(default), TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ClearTextOnFocus = false })
                corner(value, 9); stroke(value, C.border, .4)
                local track = New("TextButton", { Parent = r, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -18), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6),
                    BackgroundColor3 = C.off, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false })
                corner(track, 3)
                local span = math.max(maxV - minV, 1)
                local fill = New("Frame", { Parent = track, Size = UDim2.fromScale((default - minV) / span, 1), BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
                corner(fill, 3)
                local knob = New("Frame", { Parent = track, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = UDim2.new((default - minV) / span, 0, .5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2 })
                corner(knob, 7)
                local current = default
                local function set(v)
                    current = math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(v) or current or default) + .5), minV, maxV)
                    fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale((current - minV) / span, 1)
                    knob.Position = UDim2.new((current - minV) / span, 0, .5, 0)
                    value.Text = tostring(current)
                    cb(current)
                    farmWrite("sliders", label, current)
                end
                set(default)
                value.FocusLost:Connect(function() set(value.Text) end)
                local drag = false
                local function fromInput(i)
                    local w = track.AbsoluteSize.X
                    if w < 1 then return end
                    set(minV + span * math.clamp((i.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / w, 0, 1))
                end
                track.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
                    if isPrimaryPress(i) then drag = true; fromInput(i) end
                end)
                track.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
                    if isPrimaryPress(i) then drag = false end
                end)
                UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
                    if drag and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
                        fromInput(i)
                    end
                end)
                UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
                    if isPrimaryPress(i) then drag = false end
                end)
            end
            local function rateStr()
                local mins = (os.clock() - sessionStart) / 60
                if mins < 0.05 then return "0/min" end
                return tostring(math.floor(collected / mins)) .. "/min"
            end

            local holder = panel("Autofarm", "Round-aware · tween · dead-skip", "")
            statusLbl = New("TextLabel", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "Idle", TextColor3 = C.dim, TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left })
            makeToggle(holder, "Auto Farm", function(on)
                farming = on
                if not on then
                    stopFarm()
                    notify("Autofarm OFF", 2)
                    return
                end
                sessionStart = os.clock()
                collected = 0
                local c = LocalPlayer.Character
                if c then startCF = c:GetPivot() end
                notify("Autofarm ON · " .. farmMode, 2)
                pcall(function() workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = -50000 end)
                if noRenderOn then setNoRender(true) end
                task.spawn(function()
                    while farming do
                        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                        local r = localRoot()
                        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if not r or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Alive") == false then
                            cancelTween()
                            setStatus("Wait respawn...")
                            task.wait(0.4)
                            continue
                        end
                        if os.clock() < holdReturnUntil then
                            task.wait(0.08)
                            continue
                        end
                        local parts = scanCoins()
                        if not roundActiveNow() or #parts == 0 then
                            cancelTween()
                            restoreHumanoid()
                            if r.Position.Y < -20 then
                                local cf = lobbyCF() or startCF
                                if cf then pcall(function() r.CFrame = cf end) end
                            end
                            setStatus(roundActiveNow() and "No coins · waiting" or "Wait round...")
                            task.wait(0.5)
                            continue
                        end
                        if farmMode == "Lay" then
                            hum.AutoRotate = false
                        else
                            hum.AutoRotate = true
                        end
                        if not bagIsFull and os.clock() - lastBagT > 1 then
                            lastBagT = os.clock()
                            if bagFullGui() then bagIsFull = true end
                        end
                        if bagIsFull then
                            cancelTween()
                            setStatus("Bag full · " .. collected .. " collected")
                            if killAllOn then task.spawn(doKillAll) end
                            if shootMurdOn then doShootMurd() end
                            if resetFull then
                                voidDrop()
                                hum.Health = 0
                            else
                                restoreHumanoid()
                                goReturn()
                            end
                            task.wait(1)
                            continue
                        end
                        maybeRoleReset(hum)
                        if avoidOn then
                            local murd = findByKnife and findByKnife()
                            local hrp = murd and murd.Character and murd.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            if r and hrp then
                                local gap = r.Position - hrp.Position
                                if gap.Magnitude < 38 then
                                    setStatus("Avoid Murderer")
                                    cancelTween()
                                    local dir = gap.Magnitude > 0.1 and gap.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
                                    local flee = r.Position + dir * 45 + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
                                    pcall(function() r.CFrame = CFrame.new(flee) end)
                                    holdReturnUntil = os.clock() + 0.6
                                    task.wait(0.35)
                                    continue
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        lastMapCF = CFrame.new(parts[1].Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
                        local part, bestD = nil, 1e9
                        for n = 1, #parts do
                            local p = parts[n]
                            if p and p.Parent then
                                local d = (r.Position - p.Position).Magnitude
                                if d < bestD then bestD, part = d, p end
                            end
                        end
                        if not part then
                            task.wait(0.15)
                            continue
                        end
                        setStatus(farmMode .. " · " .. collected .. " coins · " .. rateStr())
                        moveToCoin(poseAt(part))
                        local r2 = localRoot()
                        if r2 and part and part.Parent then
                            touch(r2, part)
                            for _, bp in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                                if bp:IsA("BasePart") then touch(bp, part) end
                            end
                        end
                        task.wait(math.max(dly, 0))
                        local holdT = os.clock()
                        while part and part.Parent and not isCollected(part) and (part:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest") or part:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter")) and os.clock() - holdT < 0.75 do
                            task.wait()
                        end
                        if part and part.Parent and not isCollected(part) and (part:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest") or part:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter")) then
                            touched[part] = true
                        end
                        restoreHumanoid()
                    end
                    stopFarm()
                end)
            end, false)
            makeFarmSlider(holder, "Farm Speed", 5, 50, spd, function(v) spd = v end)
            makeFarmSlider(holder, "Farm Delay", 0, 10, dly, function(v) dly = v end)

                modeBtn.Text = "Mode: " .. farmMode
                farmWrite("dropdowns", "Mode", farmMode)
                notify("Farm mode: " .. farmMode, 2)
            end)
            local retBtn = farmBtn(holder, "Return To: " .. returnTo, function() end)

                if returnTo == "Start" then returnTo = "Map"
                elseif returnTo == "Map" then returnTo = "Lobby"
                else returnTo = "Start" end
                retBtn.Text = "Return To: " .. returnTo
                farmWrite("dropdowns", "Return", returnTo)
                notify("Return To: " .. returnTo, 2)
            end)
            farmBtn(holder, "TP To Lobby", function()
                local cf = lobbyCF()
                local r = localRoot()
                if cf and r then
                    cancelTween()
                    r.CFrame = cf
                    notify("TP → Lobby", 2)
                else
                    notify("Lobby не найден", 2)
                end
            end)
            farmBtn(holder, "Reset Character", function()
                local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                voidDrop()
                if hum then hum.Health = 0 end
            end)
            makeToggle(holder, "Auto Reset (Full Bag)", function(on)
                resetFull = on
                farmWrite("toggles", "Auto Reset (Full Bag)", on)
            end, farmRead("toggles", "Auto Reset (Full Bag)", false) == true)
            makeToggle(holder, "Avoid Murderer", function(on)
                avoidOn = on
                farmWrite("toggles", "Avoid Murderer", on)
            end, farmRead("toggles", "Avoid Murderer", false) == true)
            makeToggle(holder, "Anti-AFK", function(on)
                antiAfkOn = on
                farmWrite("toggles", "Anti-AFK", on)
                setAfk(on)
            end, farmRead("toggles", "Anti-AFK", true) == true)
            makeToggle(holder, "No Render While Farming", function(on)
                noRenderOn = on

        end
    end
